reset.confirmBody:
Only pick lists that have not been packed yet are removed. Pick lists that are already packed (status "Completed") and the stock booked with them are kept. The affected orders are reset to status "New".

This cannot be undone.
reset.skipped: {{count}} already packed pick list(s) were kept.

reseed.button: Delete the whole DB + recreate demo data (development only)
reseed.confirm:
WARNING: All data will be deleted and replaced with demo data.

This affects: articles, warehouse layout (shelves, bins), stock, orders, pick lists, walls and pick points. All items you created manually will be lost.

Continue?
reseed.confirmAgain: Really sure? Last warning — all current data will be gone.
reseed.result: {{message}} — {{articles}} articles, {{shelves}} shelves, {{bins}} bins, {{stockItems}} stock bookings, {{orders}} orders, {{walls}} walls, {{pickPoints}} pick points.

bulk.title: Bulk test data
bulk.hint: Development function (the server only allows it in the Development environment). Adds random articles (~5%), stock (~10%) and orders (~85%) in addition to the existing DB. Clicking repeatedly stacks — each run has unique BULK IDs.
bulk.confirm:
Create {{count}} random test records?

Articles, stock and orders are created IN ADDITION to the existing database and cannot be removed together again. Intended for development/test environments only.

confirm.title: Finish picking?
confirm.label: Mark as picked
confirm.body: The pick list will be marked as “picking finished”. It will then appear under “Packing” for packing.

recalc.title: Recalculate route
recalc.hint: If you changed walls, shelves or bins, this recalculates the route with the current layout. Order and waypoints are updated.

pack.title: Pick list {{number}} – Packing
pack.deviationConfirm:
Warning: the confirmed quantities deviate from the target.
This will be recorded in the pick list as is — really submit?
pack.intro: Each order becomes one parcel. Enter for each line how many pieces were actually packed — the planned quantity (or the quantity counted in the mobile picker) is pre-filled. On submit, the pick list is marked as Completed and all quantities are saved.
